Full setup guide, PC client config and troubleshooting are on the GitHub Wiki: github.com/SynacNipo/Sacram/wiki
Short version: 1. START proxy - the app becomes a WiFi Direct hotspot. 2. Connect your PC/device to the SSID shown on screen. 3. On the PC use the bundled sing-box client (SacramConnect.bat) pointing to the socks5 address shown above - TUN is required for systemwide TCP + UDP (games, DNS, UDP apps).
